name: move-coach
description: Your team's MOVE catching-sensor numbers in ChatGPT: weekly team report, practice plan, parent update and recruiting one-pager. Read-only.

interface.longDescription: Reads your team's MOVE catching-sensor data, the same numbers as the MOVE Coach dashboard, and writes four things coaches need: a weekly team report, a practice plan using your own drills, a short parent update, and a recruiting one-pager. It only reads: nothing it does changes MOVE or sends anything to anyone. Your team must be on the MOVE Coach plan. Catchers under 13 are never shared.
defaultPrompt: Weekly MOVE report for my catchers
Practice plan from this week's MOVE data
Write a parent update for one of my catchers
